svg.title: Native ingestion feeds linked deal context, permission-scoped retrieval feeds Ask and read-only MCP, while CRM writeback has separate controls.

g.text: 02 / HOW CONNECTED CONTEXT REACHES THE WORK
Ask can retrieve from the linked history.
Tenant scope and user access constrain the evidence.
Search results are checked in the permissioned store.
Briefs, answers, summaries and work items
Reading evidence does not grant permission to write.
Aida’s read-only MCP server does not send email or execute actions in external tools.
Conceptual view based on the supplied internal summary. Outbound MCP tools are intentionally not modeled here.
